description: Defines the AlpsDecoder class for parsing HTTP/2 frames in the ALPS TLS extension, including nested classes for parsing settings and ACCEPT_CH frames.

classes.name: AlpsDecoder
classes.description: Class for decoding HTTP/2 frames in the ALPS TLS extension, including nested classes for parsing settings and ACCEPT_CH frames.

classes.name: AlpsDecoder::SettingsParser
classes.description: Parses HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames, tracks frame count and errors.

classes.name: AlpsDecoder::AcceptChParser
classes.description: Parses ACCEPT_CH frames, tracks errors and accumulated values.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a stream of HTTP/2 frames received via the ALPS TLS extension.

methods.name: settings_frame_count
methods.description: Returns the number of SETTINGS frames received.
